verdict.rationale: BugSnag has an official MCP server (SmartBear MCP) with OAuth-based self-hosted login, so an agent has a documented path into error data. Errors are grouped by impact using stack-frame data, and a webhook forwards error and project data, which supports pulling and triaging top issues. Nothing in the pack shows the MCP server's tools returning stack traces, a documented REST API, or any issue-tracker integration for filing bugs; the integrations evidence covers only alerting tools (Slack, Teams, PagerDuty). Missing for 10: documented MCP tool list covering issue and stack-trace retrieval, public REST API/OpenAPI spec (probes 404), issue-tracker (e.g. Jira/GitHub) filing capability, hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
